 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full uniform lines are the separators; recover each panel's motif from
    # the panel containing the most non-background cells, then tile it.
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]
    r_bounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    panels = [(r_bounds[a]+1, r_bounds[a+1], c_bounds[b]+1, c_bounds[b+1])
              for a in range(len(r_bounds)-1) for b in range(len(c_bounds)-1)]
    panels = [p for p in panels if p[1]>p[0] and p[3]>p[2]]
    # Most ARC panels have equal size; use the most common panel dimensions.
    from collections import Counter
    dims = Counter((r1-r0,c1-c0) for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels)
    ph,pw = dims.most_common(1)[0][0]
    panels = [p for p in panels if (p[1]-p[0],p[3]-p[2])==(ph,pw)]
    def score(p):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=p
        return sum(grid[i][j] != bg for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1))
    src=max(panels,key=score)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=src
    motif=[grid[i][c0:c1] for i in range(r0,r1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,c,d in panels:
        for i in range(ph):
            for j in range(pw): out[a+i][c+j]=motif[i][j]
    return out
"
